results.title: Delhi Premier League: Warriors beat Kings by 25 runs in a thriller
results.description: Outer Delhi Warriors defeated Central Delhi Kings by 25 runs in the Delhi Premier League. Batting first, the Warriors scored 216/9, led by Yajas Sharma's 46. Despite a late scare from Jasvir Sehrawat (62), the Kings were all out for 191.

results.title: Durand Cup: NorthEast United thrash Karbi Anglong 4-1 in Group F clash
results.description: Defending champions NorthEast United FC defeated Karbi Anglong Morning Star FC 4-1 in the Durand Cup, extending their unbeaten run. Alaaeddine Ajaraie scored a brace, with substitutes Macarton and Etyan adding late goals for the Highlanders.
